extends.meaning: additive reader and writer profile; existing Wan v1 rows, defaults, delivery metadata, and mutations remain unchanged

canvasPolicy.normalization: use the shared source-aspect normalizer when its aligned result is within these bounds; otherwise enumerate every aligned bounded bucket and minimize abs((width / height) / sourceAspect - 1) + (1 - area / 414720) * 0.25, then prefer larger area, larger width, and larger height in that order
canvasPolicy.sourceGeometryPersistence: do not persist observed source width or height; persist only the selected effective width and height
canvasPolicy.firstFrame: apply EXIF orientation, use the exact selected canvas, and cover-center without blurred or synthetic side fill

canary.meaning: health-validation canvas only; not a fixed output canvas

internalClientOption.name: requireExactHealthValidation
internalClientOption.meaning: the WPF enqueue helper requires a fresh exact ready capability; the HTTP body does not contain this field

displayedManagedSource.validation: resolve the configured managed output root and selected file through lexical and canonical containment checks, require one supported regular still image, and pin size, mtime, decoded bounds, and SHA-256 before persisting
displayedManagedSource.sourceIdentity: retain the validated Original sourceId when available; when the managed file itself is the opened catalog item, sourceId and sourcePath are its canonical managed path
displayedManagedSource.persistence: persist the normal video sourceId, canonical sourcePath, sourceSignature, and sourceSha256; do not persist the request-only sourceManagedOutputPath field
displayedManagedSource.retry: revalidate the persisted sourcePath, sourceSignature, and sourceSha256 without requiring the historical producer job
displayedManagedSource.deletion: do not delete a managed image output while any queued or running video row names that exact canonical output as its persisted sourcePath; the producer-id protection inherited from video v1 also remains in force

enqueueRequest.serverMeaning: the server resolves source identity and oriented source geometry, selects the bounded source-aspect canvas from requested.maximumPixelArea, validates requested.steps independently as an integer from 1 to 40, revalidates exact readiness, and persists the effective snapshot

promptPolicy.nonBlank: requested.prompt is trimmed and copied exactly to effective.positivePrompt
promptPolicy.blankRequestedPrompt: preserve the blank requested.prompt and use the exact defaultPositivePrompt in effective.positivePrompt
promptPolicy.defaultPositivePrompt: One continuous shot with clearly visible, source-faithful motion. Preserve the visible subjects, composition, lighting, setting, and existing interactions. Use two connected motion phases: the main visible subject makes a noticeable head and upper-body shift with a clear expression change, then moves into a distinct final pose. The camera makes a smooth push-in with a small image-compatible arc; motion becomes strongest through the middle and settles cleanly at the end. Keep existing hand positions and contacts coherent unless the source action itself requires follow-through; do not invent a new gesture, touch, object, person, or cut. Hair, clothing, water, and other visible loose details follow the movement naturally. Use only image-consistent ambient sound, with no speech and no music.

passiveHealthGate.sideEffects: none; opening the board, hydrating settings, and refreshing health never enqueue, launch, wake, claim, or reorder work
passiveHealthGate.unknownOrMalformed: H3 enqueue is disabled and WPF displays a bounded health-unavailable reason; Wan v1 and passive Jobs reading remain usable
passiveHealthGate.enqueueRule: H3 can be queued only after a fresh exact ready shape observed by the enqueue helper; sourceManagedOutputPath additionally requires displayedManagedVideoSourceV1=true

persistedSnapshot.exactKnownValues: effective.width and effective.height must satisfy profile.canvasPolicy and their product must not exceed requested.maximumPixelArea; legacy rows without that field use 414720. All other values are exactly those in profile except the independently selected requested.steps; effective.positivePrompt follows promptPolicy; seed is an integer from 0 through 2147483647
persistedSnapshot.unknownFields: preserve at the job-store boundary; an H3 row containing unknown nested fields is protected rather than rewritten by the v2 mutation client
persistedSnapshot.malformedKnownOrUnknownNestedField: reader-only protected row; never cancel, retry, reorder, open, play, or delete through a managed-video mutation path
persistedSnapshot.retry: reuse the complete persisted exact H3 snapshot, prompt, pinned source identity, and seed after a fresh exact health validation; displayed managed stills retry from their persisted sourcePath and hashes without a producer lookup

readerFirst.writerRule: enable a v2 writer only after every active reader accepts v2 rows
readerFirst.rollback: after a v2 row exists, retain a v2-capable reader even if enqueue is disabled
